people.name: Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche
people.bio: Kagyu and Nyingma lama, founder of Nalandabodhi, who presents mind training and the "mindful gap" to modern audiences with humour and an interest in art and popular culture.

people.name: Ringu Tulku Rinpoche
people.bio: Karma Kagyu lama and scholar of the Rimé movement, former professor of Tibetan studies in Sikkim, who founded Bodhicharya and teaches in a light, accessible style.

people.name: Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche
people.bio: Bön lama trained at Menri under Lopön Tenzin Namdak, founder of Ligmincha International, who teaches Bön Dzogchen, dream yoga and the healing practices of sound and breath.

people.name: Brad Warner
people.bio: American Soto Zen teacher and author of Hardcore Zen, a Dharma heir of Gudo Wafu Nishijima, who talks about zazen, Dogen and everyday life with punk bluntness.

people.name: Valerie Forstman
people.bio: Associate Zen Master of the Sanbo Zen lineage and guiding teacher of Mountain Cloud Zen Center, first a student of Ruben Habito.

people.name: Shinge Roshi
people.bio: Roko Sherry Chayat, abbot of the Zen Studies Society (Dai Bosatsu Zendo) in the Rinzai line of Eido Shimano.

people.name: Chigan Roshi
people.bio: Rinzai Zen teacher with the Zen Studies Society who gives teisho on koan collections at Dai Bosatsu Zendo and New York Zendo.

people.name: Jeffrey Hopkins
people.bio: Scholar and translator of Gelug Madhyamaka and tantra, founder of the Tibetan Buddhist studies doctoral programme at the University of Virginia and the Dalai Lama's chief English interpreter 1979–89.

people.name: Lama Jampa Thaye
people.bio: British-born lama authorised in the Sakya and Karma Kagyu traditions by Karma Thinley Rinpoche, founder of the Dechen community and a scholar of Tibetan Buddhism.

people.name: Kwan Um School of Zen (various Zen Masters)
people.bio: The Kwan Um School of Zen, the international Korean Seon school founded by Zen Master Seung Sahn; the channel collects short talks by many of its Zen Masters.
channels: Kwan Um School of Zen Europe

people.name: Tendai Buddhist Institute (weekly dharma talks)
people.bio: Tendai Buddhist Institute in New York state, the American branch of Japanese Tendai; its weekly Wednesday talks cover Tiantai/Tendai doctrine and practice.

people.name: Thich Nhat Hanh
people.bio: Vietnamese Thiền master, poet and peace activist who founded Plum Village and the Order of Interbeing and taught mindful, engaged living.

people.name: The 14th Dalai Lama
people.bio: Tenzin Gyatso, 14th Dalai Lama, Gelug monk and scholar whose teachings range from Lamrim and Madhyamaka to secular ethics and dialogue with science.

people.name: Henry Shukman
people.bio: English poet and Sanbo Zen master, appointed teacher in 2010 and given Dharma transmission by Yamada Ryoun in 2020; spiritual director emeritus of Mountain Cloud Zen Center.

people.name: Foundation for Shingon Buddhism (classes and podcast)
people.bio: Foundation for Shingon Buddhism, which shares Shingon esoteric Buddhism, its texts and Koyasan culture in English.

people.name: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
people.bio: Nepal-born Kagyu and Nyingma teacher, son of Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, known for plain-language meditation teaching, neuroscience collaborations and a four-year wandering retreat; founder of Tergar.

people.name: Dzongsar Jamyang Khyentse Rinpoche
people.bio: Bhutanese Rimé lama of the Sakya and Nyingma lines, recognised as an incarnation of Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo; filmmaker, author and founder of Siddhartha's Intent and Khyentse Foundation.

people.name: B. Alan Wallace
people.bio: American scholar-practitioner ordained by the Dalai Lama and trained by Geshe Rabten, later a Stanford PhD, who teaches shamatha and Dzogchen and argues for a "contemplative science" of mind.

people.name: Khentrul Rinpoche
people.bio: Shar Khentrul Jamphel Lodrö, a Jonang master trained in a non-sectarian (Rimé) way, who teaches Kalachakra and the shentong "other-emptiness" view through Dzokden.

people.name: Robert A. F. Thurman
people.bio: American scholar and translator, the first Westerner ordained a Tibetan Buddhist monk, Jey Tsong Khapa Professor at Columbia and co-founder of Tibet House US; died in June 2026.

people.name: Master Sheng Yen
people.bio: Taiwanese Chan master of the Linji and Caodong lines and founder of Dharma Drum Mountain, who revived Chan practice and taught in the West; his Great Dharma Drum TV series answers short questions.

people.name: Tsoknyi Rinpoche
people.bio: Nyingma and Drukpa Kagyu teacher, son of Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, who teaches "essence love", the subtle body and the open-hearted awareness of Dzogchen through the Pundarika Foundation.

people.name: Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche
people.bio: Nyingma lama, son of Neten Chokling Rinpoche and former professor at Naropa, founder of Mangala Shri Bhuti, and teacher of Pema Chödrön.

people.name: Hokuto Daniel Diffin
people.bio: Rinzai Zen priest with the Zen Studies Society (Hokuto Osho) who gives Dharma talks on the Record of Linji.

people.name: Anne C. Klein (Lama Rigzin Drolma)
people.bio: Professor of Religious Studies at Rice University and, as Lama Rigzin Drolma, co-founder of Dawn Mountain in Houston, teaching Nyingma Dzogchen.

people.name: Thupten Jinpa
people.bio: Former Gelug monk with a Geshe Lharampa degree and a Cambridge PhD, principal English translator to the Dalai Lama since 1985, Tsongkhapa biographer and author of the Compassion Cultivation Training programme.

people.name: Jundo Cohen
people.bio: American Soto Zen priest living in Japan, Dharma heir of Gudo Wafu Nishijima and founder of the online Treeleaf Zendo.

people.name: Lama Tsultrim Allione
people.bio: American teacher, one of the first Western women ordained in Tibetan Buddhism (1970), founder of Tara Mandala and author of Women of Wisdom and Feeding Your Demons, a modern adaptation of Chöd.

people.name: Jan Chozen Bays
people.bio: Jan Chozen Bays, Dharma heir of Taizan Maezumi, paediatrician and co-abbot of Great Vow Zen Monastery in Oregon.

people.name: Pema Chödrön
people.bio: American nun in the Shambhala and Karma Kagyu lines, student of Chögyam Trungpa and later Dzigar Kongtrul, whose teachings on fear, groundlessness and lojong reach a wide audience.

people.name: Shunryu Suzuki
people.bio: Soto Zen priest who founded San Francisco Zen Center and Tassajara; his talks became Zen Mind, Beginner's Mind.

people.name: Rev. Meian Elbert
people.bio: Abbess of Shasta Abbey in the Order of Buddhist Contemplatives founded by Houn Jiyu-Kennett.

people.name: Jiryu Rutschman-Byler
people.bio: Soto Zen priest and former abbot of Green Gulch Farm, San Francisco Zen Center.

people.name: Anam Thubten
people.bio: Tibetan teacher trained in the Nyingma tradition who leads the Dharmata Foundation in California and teaches a direct, non-sectarian approach to awakening.

people.name: Phakchok Rinpoche
people.bio: Nyingma and Kagyu lineage holder, grandson of Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, abbot of Ka-Nying Shedrub Ling and founder of the Samye Institute.

people.name: Lama Zopa Rinpoche
people.bio: Sherpa-born Gelug lama, heart disciple of Lama Thubten Yeshe and long-time spiritual director of FPMT, known for his devotion and extended oral teachings.

people.name: Guo Gu
people.bio: Guo Gu (Jimmy Yu), Dharma heir of Master Sheng Yen and professor of religion at Florida State University, who teaches silent illumination and huatou at the Tallahassee Chan Center.

people.name: David Germano
people.bio: Professor of Tibetan and Buddhist Studies at the University of Virginia, a historian of the Great Perfection (Dzogchen) and founder of the Tibetan and Himalayan Library and UVA's Contemplative Sciences Center.
channels: The Ho Center for Buddhist Studies at Stanford

people.name: Barry Magid
people.bio: Psychiatrist and Dharma heir of Charlotte Joko Beck who founded Ordinary Mind Zendo in New York.

people.name: Elizabeth Mattis Namgyel
people.bio: American teacher in the Nyingma line of Dzigar Kongtrul Rinpoche, author of The Power of an Open Question, who explores Madhyamaka "not knowing" in daily life.

people.name: Lama Lena
people.bio: American teacher (Yeshe Kaytup) of Dzogchen and Mahamudra, a long-time student of Wangdor Rinpoche, known for informal, precise "direct mind perception" teachings streamed from many cities.

people.name: Lama Shenpen Hookham
people.bio: British Kagyu and Nyingma teacher, Oxford DPhil on shentong buddha-nature, founder of the Awakened Heart Sangha.

people.name: Brother Phap Hai
people.bio: Plum Village monastic (Brother Pháp Hải), Dharma teacher in Thich Nhat Hanh's tradition.

people.name: Kokyo Henkel
people.bio: Soto Zen priest from the San Francisco Zen Center lineage, guiding teacher of Santa Cruz Zen Center, with a strong interest in buddha-nature texts.

people.name: Jetsunma Tenzin Palmo
people.bio: British-born Drukpa Kagyu nun who spent twelve years in a Himalayan cave and founded Dongyu Gatsal Ling nunnery.

people.name: Tulku Thondup Rinpoche
people.bio: Nyingma scholar trained at Dodrupchen monastery, former visiting scholar at Harvard, author of books on healing, the Longchen Nyingthig and the hidden treasure (terma) tradition.

people.name: Lama Rod Owens
people.bio: Black, queer Kagyu lama who completed a three-year retreat under Lama Norlha Rinpoche; teaches on anger, healing and collective liberation and leads Medicine Buddha practice online.

people.name: Lama Thubten Yeshe
people.bio: Gelug lama from Sera monastery who, with Lama Zopa, founded Kopan Monastery and the FPMT and taught Westerners with warmth and humour; his talks are kept by the Lama Yeshe Wisdom Archive.
channels: Foundation for Developing Compassion and Wisdom

people.name: 34th Menri Trizin
people.bio: The 34th Menri Trizin, abbot of Menri Monastery in Dolanji and spiritual head of the Bön tradition, successor to Lungtok Tenpai Nyima (d. 2017).

people.name: Lama Willa Blythe Baker
people.bio: Kagyu lineage holder authorised after two three-year retreats, Harvard PhD (2013) and founder of Natural Dharma Fellowship and Wonderwell Mountain Refuge; teaches somatic mindfulness and Mahamudra.

people.name: Jan Willis
people.bio: Professor emerita of religion at Wesleyan and long-time student of Lama Thubten Yeshe, who writes on Tibetan hagiography, women and race in Buddhism.
channels: How to Train a Happy Mind

people.name: Tenshin Reb Anderson
people.bio: Senior Dharma teacher at San Francisco Zen Center, ordained by Shunryu Suzuki, known for close readings of Dogen and the bodhisattva precepts.

people.name: Paul L. Swanson
people.bio: Scholar and translator of Tiantai at the Nanzan Institute for Religion and Culture, translator of Zhiyi's Mohe zhiguan (Clear Serenity, Quiet Insight).

people.name: Shohaku Okumura
people.bio: Japanese Soto Zen priest, disciple of Kosho Uchiyama, translator of Dogen and founder of Sanshin Zen Community in Indiana.

people.name: Roshi Joan Halifax
people.bio: Zen teacher, anthropologist and founding abbot of Upaya Zen Center, known for work on dying, compassion and engaged Buddhism.

people.name: Donald S. Lopez Jr.
people.bio: Arthur E. Link Distinguished University Professor at Michigan, a historian of Tibetan Buddhism and of the Western reception of Buddhism.

people.name: Zen Master Dae Bong
people.bio: American Zen Master in Seung Sahn's Kwan Um School, guiding teacher at Hwagyesa International Zen Center in Seoul.

people.name: Duncan Ryūken Williams
people.bio: Soto Zen priest and professor at the University of Southern California, author of American Sutra on Japanese American Buddhists in wartime incarceration.
channels: BIPOC Sangha at East Bay Meditation Center

people.name: Alexander Berzin
people.bio: American scholar-translator who studied under Tsenzhab Serkong Rinpoche and the Dalai Lama in Dharamsala and created the Berzin Archives (now Study Buddhism), a large free library of Gelug and comparative teachings.

people.name: Brother Phap Huu
people.bio: Plum Village monastic (Brother Pháp Hữu), long-time attendant of Thich Nhat Hanh and abbot of Upper Hamlet.

people.name: Robert H. Sharf
people.bio: D. H. Chen Distinguished Professor of Buddhist Studies at UC Berkeley, a historian of Chan and Japanese Buddhism and a critic of "meditative experience" rhetoric.

people.name: Garchen Rinpoche
people.bio: Drikung Kagyu master who spent some twenty years in Chinese labour camps, where he trained under Khenpo Münsel; teaches love and compassion as the heart of Mahamudra through the Garchen Buddhist Institute in Arizona.

people.name: Sam van Schaik
people.bio: English Tibetologist at the British Library, author of Tibet: A History, Tibetan Zen and The Spirit of Zen, who works on Dunhuang manuscripts and early Dzogchen.

people.name: Brook Ziporyn
people.bio: Mircea Eliade Professor at the University of Chicago Divinity School, philosopher of Tiantai Buddhism and Zhuangzi.
channels: School of History Tel Aviv University

people.name: Geoffrey Samuel
people.bio: Anthropologist of Tibetan religion, emeritus professor at Cardiff, author of Civilized Shamans and The Origins of Yoga and Tantra.

people.name: Bernard Faure
people.bio: French historian of Chan/Zen and esoteric Buddhism, emeritus at Columbia and Stanford, trained under Yanagida Seizan in Kyoto.
channels: The Ho Center for Buddhist Studies at Stanford

people.name: Jacob P. Dalton
people.bio: Khyentse Foundation Distinguished Professor of Tibetan Buddhism at UC Berkeley, a historian of tantric ritual, the Nyingma school and the Dunhuang manuscripts.
channels: The Ho Center for Buddhist Studies at Stanford
Tang Center for Silk Road Studies, UC Berkeley

people.name: Brother Phap Linh
people.bio: Plum Village monastic (Brother Pháp Linh), Dharma teacher and musician in Thich Nhat Hanh's tradition.

people.name: Ruben Habito
people.bio: Filipino former Jesuit, Sanbo Zen teacher authorised in 1988 and founder of Maria Kannon Zen Center in Dallas.

people.name: José Ignacio Cabezón
people.bio: Dalai Lama Professor emeritus at UC Santa Barbara and former monk of Sera, who writes on Gelug and Nyingma philosophy, Sera monastery and Buddhist sexual ethics.

people.name: H.E. Asanga Vajra Rinpoche
people.bio: Sakya lama of the Phuntsok Phodrang line who teaches at Sakya Monastery of Tibetan Buddhism in Seattle.

people.name: Sakya Trizin (41st)
people.bio: Ngawang Kunga, 41st Sakya Trizin, head of the Sakya school for over five decades and now known as Sakya Trichen.

people.name: John Daido Loori
people.bio: Dharma heir of Taizan Maezumi who founded Zen Mountain Monastery and the Mountains and Rivers Order, combining zazen, koans and the arts.

people.name: Sister Chan Duc (Annabel Laity)
people.bio: Sister Chân Đức (Annabel Laity), senior English-born Dharma teacher of Plum Village.

people.name: Zen Master Seung Sahn
people.bio: Korean Seon master of the Jogye order who founded the Kwan Um School of Zen and taught "only don't know".

people.name: Janet Gyatso
people.bio: Hershey Professor of Buddhist Studies at Harvard, a scholar of Tibetan visionary autobiography, medicine and gender.

people.name: Steven Heine
people.bio: Scholar of Dogen and Zen koans at Florida International University.

people.name: Taigen Dan Leighton
people.bio: Soto Zen priest and Dharma heir of Tenshin Reb Anderson, translator of Dogen and Hongzhi, guiding teacher of Ancient Dragon Zen Gate in Chicago.

people.name: Dosho Port
people.bio: Soto Zen teacher in the Dainin Katagiri line who hosts interviews with Zen teachers.

people.name: Kenneth K. Tanaka
people.bio: Shin Buddhist priest and scholar, professor emeritus at Musashino University, writing on Pure Land thought and Buddhism in America.

people.name: Dennis Hirota
people.bio: Scholar and translator of Shinran, head translator of the Collected Works of Shinran.
channels: Theophaneia: Dispatches from the Eighth Clime

people.name: Peter N. Gregory
people.bio: Scholar of Chinese Buddhism, author of Tsung-mi and the Sinification of Buddhism, a central study of Huayan and Chan.
channels: The Ho Center for Buddhist Studies at Stanford
Theophaneia: Dispatches from the Eighth Clime

people.name: Richard K. Payne
people.bio: Scholar of Shingon ritual and tantric Buddhism, long-time dean of the Institute of Buddhist Studies in Berkeley.
channels: The University of Chicago Graham School

people.name: John R. McRae
people.bio: Historian of early Chinese Chan, author of The Northern School and Seeing through Zen, trained by Stanley Weinstein and Yanagida Seizan.

people.name: Charles B. Jones
people.bio: Scholar of Chinese Pure Land and Taiwanese Buddhism at the Catholic University of America, author of Pure Land: History, Tradition, and Practice.

people.name: 17th Karmapa Ogyen Trinley Dorje
people.bio: Ogyen Trinley Dorje, one of the two claimants recognised as the 17th Gyalwang Karmapa, head of the Karma Kagyu, who teaches on compassion, environment and Kagyu history.

people.name: Karl Brunnhölzl
people.bio: German physician-turned-scholar and translator of Kagyu texts on Madhyamaka, Mahamudra and buddha-nature.

people.name: Khenpo Sodargye
people.bio: Nyingma scholar from Larung Gar in eastern Tibet who teaches widely in Chinese.

people.name: Sister Chan Khong
people.bio: Vietnamese nun and social worker, Thich Nhat Hanh's closest collaborator in relief work and co-founder of Plum Village.

people.name: Bodhin Kjolhede
people.bio: Abbot of the Rochester Zen Center and Dharma heir of Philip Kapleau.

people.name: Mark L. Blum
people.bio: Scholar of Japanese Pure Land Buddhism at UC Berkeley and translator of Honen and the Nirvana Sutra.

people.name: T. Griffith Foulk
people.bio: Scholar of Chan and Zen monastic institutions at Sarah Lawrence College and co-editor of the Soto Zen Text Project.
